exposure: risk factors for amniotic fluid embolism
outcome: meeting criteria for amniotic fluid embolism diagnosis
demographic and clinical characteristics associated with amniotic fluid embolism
cohort: 29 women with amniotic fluid embolism (8 from two hospital systems and 21 from the published literature)
finding: The proposed criteria for diagnosing amniotic fluid embolism identified more patients compared to existing criteria, and several clinical and demographic associations were found, including a possible link between cesarean birth and risk of AFE.
mod_finding: A possible relationship between cesarean birth and risk of amniotic fluid embolism was identified.
